notes.subject: fix(linux): drop macOS node-pty from Linux VSIXs and require Secret Service
notes.summary: Linux VSIXs no longer ship macOS node-pty, and shared credential storage on Linux now requires Secret Service and fails with LinuxCredentialStoreUnavailableError instead of silently using the reboot-volatile kernel keyring unless linuxStore: "keyutils" is passed.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): add per-chat sandboxed scratch folder with downloadable outputs
notes.summary: Desktop Ask Agent on macOS gets a per-chat sandboxed scratch folder with command, file write and present_files tools, and files it presents show as inline images or downloadable chips.

notes.subject: feat(cli): ship Linux x64 and arm64 builds with environment API keys for headless hosts
notes.summary: The CLI now ships Linux x64 and arm64 builds with installer and self-update support, and can use AGENTLINK_OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or a provider's apiKeyEnv on hosts without Secret Service.

notes.subject: feat(terminal): enable the Native Agent terminal on Linux
notes.summary: Local glibc Linux hosts now run approved agent commands in the AgentLink terminal when the VSIX includes the node-pty prebuild, honouring the Linux terminal profile and env settings.

notes.subject: feat(sandbox): add a bubblewrap backend for Linux, not yet enabled
notes.summary: The sandbox helper and @agentlink/sandbox gain a bubblewrap backend for Linux x64/arm64 with a prerequisites checker, though no AgentLink surface routes to it yet.

notes.subject: feat(sandbox): run sandboxed agent commands under bubblewrap on Linux
notes.summary: VS Code on local glibc Linux now runs sandboxed agent commands under bubblewrap when the host passes the prerequisites check and attestation, otherwise falling back or blocking sandbox-only requests with a clear diagnostic.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): run the scratch-folder sandbox on Linux
notes.summary: The Browser Ask Agent scratch-folder sandbox now works on local Linux under bubblewrap when prerequisites pass, using bash and a C.UTF-8 locale and hiding /home.

notes.subject: fix(sandbox): fixes from testing the Linux sandbox on four distros
notes.summary: Linux sandbox fixes found on four distros: symlinked tools are accepted, the which command is required, and Node.js 20 or later is required for the sandbox helper.

notes.subject: feat(desktop): build and run AgentLink Desktop on Linux as an AppImage
notes.summary: Desktop now builds and runs on Linux x64 and arm64 as an AppImage, with Secret Service credentials, Linux window chrome and tray, and the Ask Agent sandbox under bubblewrap.

notes.subject: feat(desktop): ship a Linux deb with an AppArmor profile and build Linux Desktop in CI
notes.summary: Linux Desktop builds now also produce a deb that installs an AppArmor profile so Chromium keeps its renderer sandbox on Ubuntu 24.04, and CI builds and smoke-tests the Linux packages.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): run sandboxed commands in granted folders with approval
notes.summary: Ask Agent can now run sandboxed commands in folders you grant for commands, each behind an approval card with Run, edit or Reject. New grants can only be added from the same computer, and workspace-host and the approval protocol gain sandbox options.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): command rules and Approve for Me in granted folders
notes.summary: Ask Agent commands in folders granted for commands can now be allowed, prompted or forbidden by saved rules and an Approve for Me setting, with rule rows on the approval card and management in the local access panel.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): network access and Mac-only escalation for granted-folder commands
notes.summary: Ask Agent commands in granted folders can request internet access with per-destination approval cards, or run unsandboxed with a this-computer-only Full terminal access approval; the sandbox launcher gains a publicNetwork option.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): file edit tools in folders granted for commands
notes.summary: The Ask Agent can now edit files in folders granted for commands using write_file with absolute paths and a new apply_diff tool, with diff approval cards and protections for instruction, Git and .env files.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): background commands in folders granted for commands
notes.summary: Ask Agent can now run long-running background commands (dev servers, watchers) in granted folders, with new list_commands and stop_command tools, a Background label and time limit on command cards, and edits that wait for commands that can write in the folder.}]}</br>```json is not allowed so I will

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): agent-requested folder access and Manage access panel
notes.summary: Ask Agent can now request folder access through a new request_folder_access approval card, and the access panel becomes Manage access with a Show scratch folder in Finder action in Desktop and an improved manual grant form.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): edit files without asking in folders approved on a card
notes.summary: Approving a folder for commands in Ask Agent now also lets the agent create and edit files there without a card, with a per-folder "Edit files without asking" toggle in Manage access.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): Approve for Me toggle in the composer
notes.summary: Ask Agent gains an Approve for Me toggle in the composer, tied to its granted-folder command policy, and Desktop's "File access..." menu item is renamed "Manage access...". .

notes.subject: fix(chat): drop empty reply placeholder between batched queued messages
notes.summary: Fixes a stray empty "(No response)" assistant row appearing between batched queued user messages while a turn is still running.

notes.subject: fix(ask-agent): drop duplicate inline streaming indicator
notes.summary: Ask Agent no longer shows a duplicate inline streaming indicator alongside the pinned status bar above the composer.

notes.subject: feat(chat): reveal the terminal a completed command ran in
notes.summary: Clicking a finished execute_command in the transcript now focuses the terminal it ran in if still open, or shows a notice if it has closed.

notes.subject: feat(agent): prompt foreground agents to recall earlier sessions
notes.summary: Foreground agents are now prompted to recall earlier sessions via session search tools when the user refers to prior work not visible in the current conversation.

notes.subject: feat: add frozen work summaries to final status cards
notes.summary: Final status cards in VS Code now include a frozen Work summary with per-file rows and expandable read-only diffs, also served on demand to browser and Desktop remote views and exposed as new protocol types.

notes.subject: test(retrieval): give LanceDB contract tests a load-tolerant timeout
notes.summary: Test-only change giving the LanceDB retrieval contract tests a longer timeout under load; no shipped behaviour changes.

notes.subject: feat: make work summary cards collapsible
notes.summary: The Work summary card can now be collapsed to a header that still shows the file and line totals inline.

notes.subject: fix(chat): mark the chat tab that owns a pending question
notes.summary: Chat tabs now show Needs input when they own a pending question or approval, including restored questions and ones raised by background agents, and the VS Code and browser tab lists refresh when that changes.
